label: Licenses cap concurrency
subgoals: Treat the license count as the concurrency limit
Divide jobs by licenses, rounding up, to count waves
Multiply waves by job length for the wall time

label: License utilization
subgoals: Compute the license-hours offered over the wall time
Compute the license-hours the jobs actually use
Divide used by offered to get utilization

label: Check in licenses early
subgoals: Split each job into licensed and unlicensed phases
Schedule licensed phases back to back in waves
Add only the last wave's unlicensed phase to the wall time
